title: Epic Games' 'Fortnite' returns to App Stores worldwide
title_zh: Epic Games 的《堡垒之夜》重返全球应用商店
summary: Epic Games said on Tuesday its popular shooter title "Fortnite" has returned to global App ‌Stores, as the videogame maker signaled confidence in ‌a favorable outcome from an ongoing lawsuit against Apple.
summary_zh: Epic Games 周二表示，其热门射击游戏《堡垒之夜》已重返全球应用商店，这家视频游戏制造商表示对针对苹果正在进行的诉讼取得有利结果充满信心。

title_zh: 科技周刊：数据中心交易、Meta 的重大裁员

summary_zh: 故事：从数据中心交易到 Meta 的重大裁员，这是《科技周刊》。:: 科技周刊谷歌和黑石周一宣布，他们正在组建一家人工智能云业务企业。他们的目标是利用人工智能数据中心的强劲需求。主要资产管理公司 Bl...

title: Nvidia's outlook will be a test of its strategy to maintain AI dominance
title_zh: 英伟达的前景将是对其维持人工智能主导地位的战略的考验
summary: Nvidia is expected to deliver another blockbuster earnings report on Wednesday, but a shift in how artificial intelligence is used is raising doubts on how long its dominance in AI chips ‌can last.
summary_zh: 英伟达预计将在周三发布另一份重磅收益报告，但人工智能使用方式的转变引发了人们对其在人工智能芯片领域的主导地位能持续多久的怀疑。

title: Yahoo Finance unleashes AlphaSpace: Here's how you can use it to prepare for Nvidia earnings day
title_zh: 雅虎财经推出 AlphaSpace：以下是如何使用它为 Nvidia 财报日做准备
summary: Yahoo Finance's AlphaSpace is here, and it's a game-changer for the average investor.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的 AlphaSpace 来了，对于普通投资者来说，它改变了游戏规则。

title: Trump traded over $50 million in 'Magnificent 7' stocks last quarter, loading up on Apple and Google and selling Tesla
title_zh: 特朗普上季度交易了超过 5000 万美元的“Magnificent 7”股票，买入苹果和谷歌并出售特斯拉
summary: President Trump made 94 different trades of 'Magnificent 7' stocks in the first quarter of 2026, a new ethics disclosure shows, executing millions of dollars in transactions even as he was meeting with and often promoting these top tech companies.
summary_zh: 一份新的道德披露显示，特朗普总统在 2026 年第一季度对“Magnificent 7”股票进行了 94 笔不同的交易，即使在他会见并经常宣传这些顶级科技公司的同时，也执行了数百万美元的交易。

title: SpaceX IPO Adds Second Musk Stock. It’s a Problem for Tesla
title_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股增加了第二只马斯克股票。这对特斯拉来说是个问题
summary: (Bloomberg) -- For years, there was only one way for mom-and-pop investors to buy into Elon Musk’s vision: shares of Tesla Inc. That’s about to change — and it’s a serious risk for Tesla investors.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——多年来，散户投资者只有一种方式来购买埃隆·马斯克的愿景：特斯拉公司的股票。这种情况即将改变——这对特斯拉投资者来说是一个严重的风险。

title: Moonshot AI to Overhaul Structure to Win Nod for Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: Moonshot AI 将彻底改革架构以赢得香港 IPO 的批准
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Moonshot AI has informed its investors it will revamp its corporate structure to pave the way for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, aligning with Beijing’s tightened requirements for Chinese companies seeking an overseas debut.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Moonshot AI 已通知投资者，它将调整其公司结构，为在香港首次公开募股铺平道路，以符合北京方面对寻求海外上市的中国公司的严格要求。

title: Meta Moves 7,000 Workers Into AI Roles Ahead of Job Cuts
title_zh: Meta 在裁员之前将 7,000 名员工调入人工智能岗位
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Meta Platforms Inc. is reassigning 7,000 workers to new jobs related to artificial intelligence, according to an internal memo, part of a broad corporate restructuring that includes planned staff reductions later this week.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——根据一份内部备忘录，Meta Platforms Inc. 正在将 7,000 名员工重新分配到与人工智能相关的新岗位，这是广泛的公司重组的一部分，其中包括计划在本周晚些时候裁员。
